title: MongoDB Examples
description: Use these examples with the setup steps in their lessons. These technologies need tools on your computer and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: MongoDB: Read a book document
examples.description: The braces hold the document. title and pages are fields. The title is text. The page count is a number. This first example just shows the shape of the data.

examples.title: Setting Up Atlas and mongosh
examples.description: Follow the setting up atlas and mongosh lesson to set up this example. Read the code, then change one small value and try it on your computer.

examples.title: Documents and Collections
examples.description: Follow the documents and collections lesson to set up this example. Read the code, then change one small value and try it on your computer.
examples.code:
use shop
db.products.insertOne({
  _id: 1,
  name: 'Desk lamp',
  price: 24.5,
  stock: 40,
  active: true,
  tags: ['led', 'office'],
  dimensions: { height: 45, base: 18 },
  addedOn: new Date('2026-02-01'),
  discontinuedOn: null
})
db.products.findOne({ _id: 1 })
examples.output:
switched to db shop
{ acknowledged: true, insertedId: 1 }
{
  _id: 1,
  name: 'Desk lamp',
  price: 24.5,
  stock: 40,
  active: true,
  tags: [ 'led', 'office' ],
  dimensions: { height: 45, base: 18 },
  addedOn: ISODate('2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
  discontinuedOn: null
}

examples.title: Transactions
examples.description: Follow the transactions lesson to set up this example. Read the code, then change one small value and try it on your computer.
examples.code:
use shop
db.accounts.insertMany([{ _id: 'ann', balance: 100 }, { _id: 'ben', balance: 20 }])
const session = db.getMongo().startSession()
session.startTransaction()
const accounts = session.getDatabase('shop').accounts
accounts.updateOne({ _id: 'ann' }, { $inc: { balance: -50 } })
accounts.updateOne({ _id: 'ben' }, { $inc: { balance: 50 } })
session.commitTransaction()
session.endSession()
db.accounts.find()
examples.output:
switched to db shop
{ acknowledged: true, insertedIds: { '0': 'ann', '1': 'ben' } }
{
  acknowledged: true,
  insertedId: null,
  matchedCount: 1,
  modifiedCount: 1,
  upsertedCount: 0
}
{
  acknowledged: true,
  insertedId: null,
  matchedCount: 1,
  modifiedCount: 1,
  upsertedCount: 0
}
[ { _id: 'ann', balance: 50 }, { _id: 'ben', balance: 70 } ]
